subject.title: refactor(state): move device identity into canonical SQLite state

question: Should Apple runtimes be permitted to claim/import legacy `identity/device.json` themselves, or must legacy device-identity migration remain exclusively owned by `openclaw doctor --fix`?
rationale: This decision determines the supported upgrade, recovery, mixed-version, and downgrade contract for a cryptographic device identity; the repository policy favors Doctor-owned migration, while the PR describes native Apple import coordination.

options.title: Keep migration Doctor-only
options.body: Make Apple runtime identity reads fail closed when legacy state exists and direct recovery through `openclaw doctor --fix`, retaining one explicit migration owner.

options.title: Approve a native exception
options.body: Allow Apple import only with a documented policy exception, exact fallback-source rules, and proof that mixed-version and interrupted claims cannot rotate an existing identity.

options.title: Defer the cutover
options.body: Keep the JSON owner until the cross-runtime migration and downgrade contract has an approved release plan.

recommendation.title: Keep migration Doctor-only
recommendation.body: Make Apple runtime identity reads fail closed when legacy state exists and direct recovery through `openclaw doctor --fix`, retaining one explicit migration owner.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor owns the active device-identity migration stack and can provide the concrete design and proof needed for the maintainer decision.
